name: brain
description: Second-brain capture for an Obsidian vault: dump what you just learned by voice or text and /note places it in the right learning folder, writes it up in your own note-taking voice (not AI voice), wires up bidirectional wikilinks, and updates the index hub. Vault located via $OBSIDIAN_VAULT or by finding .obsidian/, learning folder from 99 Meta/Paths.md.
